description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Guardrail polylines and route-measure attributes identify roadside safety assets in unincorporated Pierce County. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including collector, structure, gps_date, gps_time, rcvr_type, fm_x_coord. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. Location/length attributes do not establish crash performance, maintenance condition or full network coverage. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
